interface Numbers extends IterableIterator<number> {}
function* count(): Numbers {
  yield 1;
}
interface CustomIter {
  next(input: string): { done?: false; value: number } | { done: true; value: boolean };
}
function* custom(): CustomIter {
  const s: string = yield 42;
  return s.length > 0;
}
const k = function* () {
  yield 2;
};
k.tag = 5;
k['label'] = 'g';
const it = custom();
console.log(k.tag, k.label, [...k()], [...count()], it.next('ignored').value, it.next('ok').value);
